overview.Name: Gorilla Technology Group Inc.
overview.Description: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. provides solutions in security, network, business intelligence, and Internet of Things (IoT) technology in Taiwan and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Video IoT, Security Convergence, and Other segments. The company offers building and office; policing; railway; road; port; airport; retail; healthcare infrastructure security; safe school and universities; and parking solution. Gorilla Technology Group Inc. is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
